title: Vasopressor comparative effectiveness
summary: Candidate target-trial coordinates for vasopressor strategies in ICU observational data. The full target-trial protocol and observational-data mapping must be frozen before outcomes are inspected. A recorded administration supports exposure, but record absence is not verified non-use unless a source-specific negative-evidence contract proves complete capture; without that contract, the causal contrast fails closed before a control arm is constructed.

design_candidates.population: Patients simultaneously eligible for the compared vasopressor strategies at a reproducible treatment-decision landmark.
design_candidates.time_zero: The common treatment-eligibility and assignment time; avoid defining treatment using information after this point.
design_candidates.observation_window: Pre-treatment confounders and severity measurements available before assignment, with treatment history represented when needed.
design_candidates.prediction_or_followup_window: Follow from assignment to a prespecified mortality, organ-support, or discharge horizon with competing events defined.
eligibility_candidates: Specify treatment strategies and grace-period handling before outcome inspection
Require source-specific administration capture and verified non-use before constructing a binary control arm
Assess prespecified propensity support and covariate balance before effect estimation
design_candidates.exposure: A prespecified initiation or active-comparator strategy measured from the common landmark under a source contract that distinguishes recorded use, verified non-use, and unavailable capture.
design_candidates.outcome: Mortality, shock resolution, or organ-support-free outcome with an explicit follow-up horizon.
design_candidates.estimand: Intention-to-treat or per-protocol contrast between clearly defined vasopressor strategies in the eligible target population.
recommended_methods: Freeze the target-trial protocol, estimand, assumptions, and observational-data mapping before outcome contrasts
Use cloning, censoring, and weighting when a treatment grace period creates time-dependent assignment
Use prespecified propensity support, weight handling, and post-adjustment balance diagnostics
sensitivity_analyses: Negative-control or quantitative unmeasured-confounding analysis when justified

stop_conditions: A common eligibility and treatment-assignment time cannot be identified
Medication record absence cannot be distinguished from verified non-use for a proposed non-initiation arm
Comparator strategies lack prespecified propensity support or pretreatment confounder timing
requires_confirmation: Confirm eligibility, treatment strategies, time zero, grace period, follow-up, estimand, censoring, and positivity response
Confirm the source-specific positive and negative medication-evidence contract
